notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Palinchron to your hand from the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.
